services.desc: Captain Spencer has designed his Charter Pricing to be competitive and provide more value with no hidden charges. All prices are visible on this website and documented for public viewing. Captain Spencer’s Fishing Charters are fixed-priced for 2 people. There is an additional fee for each person over the 2 passengers. The maximum number of passengers per boat is 4 adults and potentially 2 children. For the Gulf Sunset Charter (a non-fishing charter), the pricing is per boat, and there is no cost for passengers. You can purchase optional merchandise on board, such as hats, sunglasses, tee-shirts, insulated cooler fish bags, etc. Please note: Captain Spencer’s prices are completely listed
